prime_11_collision.interpretation: The two golden values coalesce at 5 modulo 11; after division by 11 their centered first digits are +/-5 on the two sqrt(5) sheets.

interpretation: Direct D5--S3 kernel intersection is empty in characteristic zero, so the mod-11 Bockstein rank equation does not lift literally. The normalized apolar cross-Gram invariant of the two kernel planes takes two conjugate Q(sqrt(5)) values, each on thirty pairs. Choosing either golden value cuts out a (6_5,10_3) design, and Galois conjugation exchanges the design with its complement.
